[SWS_Rte_72022]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00306, SRS_Rte_00300, SRS_Rte_00303, SRS_Rte_00179
⌈The associated Cross Software Cluster Communication Plug-In to a
Data Communication Graph shall provide the Rte_Rips_DataIsUpdated_-
EventActivation Service for each RunnableEntity accessing a VariableDat-
aPrototype in the role dataReadAccess, or dataReceivePointByValue, or
dataReceivePointByArgument, if
• for the related Data Communication Graph the Cross Software Clus-
ter Communication Plug-In support is enabled
AND
• the RunnableEntity accessing a VariableDataPrototype is triggered by
a DataReceivedEvent.
⌋
[SWS_Rte_82016]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00246
⌈The RTE Generator shall invoke Rte_Rips_DataIsUpdated_EventActivation
Service and evaluate its return value (See [SWS_Rte_72000], [SWS_Rte_72001]) to
determine whether or not it shall fire the related DataReceivedEvent if for the related
Data Communication Graph the Cross Software Cluster Communication
Plug-In support is enabled.⌋
